cohort: Pregnant women, with and without a diagnosis of intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP), totaling 72 participants (30 in the ICP group and 42 in the control group).
finding: Fetuses of mothers with ICP had a significantly larger aortic isthmus (AoI) diameter compared to controls, and this enlarged AoI diameter was significantly associated with the requirement for NICU admission.
